<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.DistanceToOutlet: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Calculates the distance of each cell from the outlet, along the drainage directions. The outlets must be marked with the value 10 in the drainage directions, for example with MarkOutlets: the paths that leave the map elsewhere get 0.

**Toolbox folder:** Network<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Network, Distance to outlet, Drainage directions<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.DistanceToOutlet`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPit` | raster file | m |  | The optional map of the depitted elevation, to measure the distances in 3D, with the meters mode. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions, with the outlets marked with 10. |
| `pMode` | int |  | `0` | The unit of the distance: 0 for meters, 1 for the number of cells crossed. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outDistance` | output file | m or cells | The map of the distance to the outlet. |
